description: Source code for OpenHashMap class in Apache Spark, implementing a fast hash map for nullable keys with insert and update support, using an underlying OpenHashSet.

classes.name: OpenHashMap
classes.description: A high-performance hash map supporting nullable keys, optimized for insertions and updates, used internally in Spark.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, throws if key not present.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key as an Option, None if not present.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Sets the value for a key in the map.

methods.name: changeValue
methods.description: Updates or inserts a key with a default or merged value.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over key-value pairs in the map.

methods.name: grow
methods.description: Resizes internal arrays for the hash map.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves data from old position to new position during rehashing.
